issues.title: BLU-019 follow-up: atomic completion and timeout/cancellation

criteria.requirement: At-most-once dispatch after crash and concurrent callers, with atomic claim required by store contract

tests.name: crash after send before completion fails closed on restart
concurrent callers have exactly one send

criteria.requirement: Timeout, cancellation, malformed input and happy path covered with real flutter_test

tests.name: completed operation is not executed twice
timeout does not replay an uncertain external send
cancellation during send preserves claim and prevents replay
malformed operation IDs and timeouts are rejected

criteria.requirement: No egress or secrets in standalone retry module; uncertain operations fail closed

tests.name: checkpoint with mismatched operation id fails closed

criteria.requirement: flutter analyze and relevant tests pass in CI
criteria.reason: CI verification is required; writing tests alone is not evidence of a successful run.

criteria.requirement: Atomic durable encrypted checkpoint implementation, WorkflowExecution/BLU-018 wiring, offline/permission, device and TCC validation
criteria.reason: No production RetryCheckpointStore is installed; memory fake only. Atomic claim prevents duplicate invocation only when the store persists the claim before the send. A destination-side idempotency key is needed for at-least-once delivery. Native permissions and device/TCC tests require manual hardware validation.
